original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true when config.review.enabled is true.
refined: Calling shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") with config.review.enabled === true returns boolean true

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns true when config.execution.rectification.enabled is true.
refined: Calling shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") with config.execution.rectification.enabled === true returns boolean true

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") returns false when both config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled are absent or false.
refined: Calling shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "implementer") with config.review.enabled === false and config.execution.rectification.enabled === false returns boolean false

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "test-writer") returns false regardless of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values.
refined: Calling shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "test-writer") returns boolean false for any combination of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values

original: shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "verifier") returns false regardless of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values.
refined: Calling shouldKeepSessionOpen(config, "verifier") returns boolean false for any combination of config.review.enabled and config.execution.rectification.enabled values

original: shouldRunReview(config) returns true when config.review.enabled is true.
refined: Calling shouldRunReview(config) with config.review.enabled === true returns boolean true

original: shouldRunReview(config) returns false when config.review is absent.
refined: Calling shouldRunReview(config) with config.review === undefined returns boolean false

original: shouldRunRectification(config) returns true when config.execution.rectification.enabled is true.
refined: Calling shouldRunRectification(config) with config.execution.rectification.enabled === true returns boolean true

original: shouldRunRectification(config) returns false when config.execution.rectification is absent.
refined: Calling shouldRunRectification(config) with config.execution.rectification === undefined returns boolean false

original: Given `src/tdd/session-runner.ts` is inspected after US-001, when locating keepOpen assignment, then the expression includes `shouldKeepSessionOpen(` and does not include the prior inline `role === "implementer" && (config.execution.rectification?.enabled ?? false)` expression.
refined: File src/tdd/session-runner.ts contains string shouldKeepSessionOpen( in a keepOpen variable assignment and does not contain string role === "implementer" && (config.execution.rectification?.enabled ?? false) in that same assignment context

original: Given `src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts` is inspected after US-001, when locating keepOpen assignment, then the expression includes `shouldKeepSessionOpen(` and does not include the prior inline `ctx.config.review?.enabled === true || ctx.config.execution.rectification?.enabled === true` expression.
refined: File src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts contains string shouldKeepSessionOpen( in a keepOpen variable assignment and does not contain string ctx.config.review?.enabled === true || ctx.config.execution.rectification?.enabled === true in that same assignment context

original: SessionKeeper.send() returns the TurnResult from agentManager.runAsSession on success.
refined: SessionKeeper.send() returns the exact TurnResult object received from agentManager.runAsSession when no error occurs

original: SessionKeeper.send() calls sessionManager.getLiveHandle(sessionName) before openSession, and when a live handle with matching agentName exists, SessionKeeper.send() reuses that handle.
refined: When sessionManager.getLiveHandle(sessionName) returns a SessionHandle with agentName matching opts.defaultAgent, sessionManager.openSession is not called and the returned handle is passed to agentManager.runAsSession

original: Given no matching live handle exists, when SessionKeeper.send() runs, then it calls sessionManager.openSession and uses the returned handle.
refined: When sessionManager.getLiveHandle(sessionName) returns null or a handle with non-matching agentName, sessionManager.openSession is called exactly once with opts.sessionName, and its returned handle is passed to agentManager.runAsSession

original: Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: true, when retryStrategy.shouldRetry returns retry: true, then SessionKeeper.send() closes the stale handle and retries.
refined: When agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable=true, retryStrategy.shouldRetry is called with the error; if it returns {retry:true}, sessionManager.closeSession is invoked on the stale handle.id and agentManager.runAsSession is called again with the same prompt

original: Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: true, when retryStrategy is absent or returns retry: false, then SessionKeeper.send() re-throws the error.
refined: When SessionTurnError with retryable=true is thrown and opts.retryStrategy is undefined, or retryStrategy.shouldRetry returns {retry:false}, the error is re-thrown to the caller without retry or recovery

original: Given agentManager.runAsSession throws SessionTurnError with retryable: false, when SessionKeeper.send() handles the error, then it re-throws immediately without calling retryStrategy.shouldRetry.
refined: When SessionTurnError with retryable=false is thrown, retryStrategy.shouldRetry is never invoked and the error is re-thrown to the caller immediately

original: SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() calls sessionManager.bindHandle(heldHandle.id, sessionName, protocolIds) when heldHandle.protocolIds is defined.
refined: When heldHandle is held and heldHandle.protocolIds is defined, bindProtocolIds() calls sessionManager.bindHandle exactly once with arguments (heldHandle.id, opts.sessionName, heldHandle.protocolIds)

original: SessionKeeper.bindProtocolIds() performs no sessionManager.bindHandle call when heldHandle.protocolIds is undefined.
refined: When heldHandle is held and heldHandle.protocolIds is undefined, sessionManager.bindHandle is not called

original: SessionKeeper.close() calls sessionManager.closeSession for the held handle when one exists and does not throw when no handle is held.
refined: SessionKeeper.close() calls sessionManager.closeSession(heldHandle.id) when a handle is held; when no handle is held, close() completes without throwing and without calling closeSession

original: Given `src/verification/rectification-loop.ts` is inspected after US-002, when searching for the previous session retry block, then the previous inline `while (true)` loop used for `getLiveHandle/openSession/runAsSession` is removed and SessionKeeper usage is present.
refined: File src/verification/rectification-loop.ts does not contain the pattern `while (true)` or `while(true)` used for session retry/transport retry, and contains at least one instantiation of `new SessionKeeper` or `SessionKeeper` variable assignment

original: Given `src/tdd/rectification-gate.ts` is inspected after US-002, when searching for the previous session retry block, then the previous inline `while (true)` loop used for `getLiveHandle/openSession/runAsSession` is removed and SessionKeeper usage is present.
refined: File src/tdd/rectification-gate.ts does not contain the pattern `while (true)` or `while(true)` used for session retry/transport retry, and contains at least one instantiation of `new SessionKeeper` or `SessionKeeper` variable assignment

original: implementerOp.kind equals "run", implementerOp.session.role equals "implementer", and implementerOp.session.lifetime equals "warm".
refined: implementerOp.kind === "run" AND implementerOp.session.role === "implementer" AND implementerOp.session.lifetime === "warm"

original: testWriterOp.session.role equals "test-writer" and testWriterOp.session.lifetime equals "fresh".
refined: testWriterOp.session.role === "test-writer" AND testWriterOp.session.lifetime === "fresh"

original: verifierOp.session.role equals "verifier" and verifierOp.session.lifetime equals "fresh".
refined: verifierOp.session.role === "verifier" AND verifierOp.session.lifetime === "fresh"

original: Given implementerOp.parse receives empty or unparseable output, when parse executes, then it returns ImplementerOutput with success: false and filesChanged: [].
refined: implementerOp.parse("", mockInput, mockCtx) returns { success: false, filesChanged: [], estimatedCostUsd: number, durationMs: number }

original: Given upgraded TDD op parse cannot produce a usable value and op-level recover can derive output from disk artifacts, when callOp post-parse flow runs, then it returns recovered output instead of throwing parse failure.
refined: When implementerOp/testWriterOp/verifierOp.parse throws and op.recover returns valid output, callOp returns the recovered output without re-throwing

original: When runTddSessionOp routes by op.session.role, then it dispatches via callOp to implementerOp, testWriterOp, or verifierOp and does not call runTddSession() directly.
refined: runTddSessionOp calls callOp(ctx, implementerOp/testWriterOp/verifierOp, input) for corresponding roles and never calls runTddSession() function

original: Given `src/operations/index.ts` is inspected after US-003, when reading exports, then `TddRunOp` is not exported.
refined: grep -c "export.*TddRunOp" src/operations/index.ts returns 0 (no exports of TddRunOp)

original: Given role-tag wiring tests are inspected after US-003, when checking `test/unit/tdd/session-op.test.ts`, then the file does not exist.
refined: test/unit/tdd/session-op.test.ts does not exist on disk after completion

original: OrchestratorSlot<I, O, C> is generic; the typed add* methods accept the typed op + input without requiring callers to cast (no `as unknown as RunOperation<unknown, ...>` at call sites).
refined: TypeScript strict mode compilation succeeds when calling builder.addImplementer(typedOp, typedInput), builder.addTestWriter(typedOp, typedInput), etc., without `as` casts. The builder's type parameters correctly infer and enforce input/output type matching for each add* method.

original: Given addImplementer was never called, when StoryOrchestratorBuilder.build(ctx) is invoked, then it throws NaxError with code "ORCHESTRATOR_NO_IMPLEMENTER".
refined: Calling StoryOrchestratorBuilder.build(ctx) without a prior addImplementer() call throws NaxError with message matching /ORCHESTRATOR_NO_IMPLEMENTER/ and context.stage="execution".

original: ExecutionPlan.run() executes slots in canonical order: test-writer (if added) → implementer → verifier (if added) → semantic review (if added) → adversarial review (if added) → rectification (if added); any slot not added is skipped. addAdversarialReview uses the existing adversarialReviewOp / AdversarialReviewInput from src/operations/adversarial-review.ts; addSemanticReview uses the existing semanticReviewOp / SemanticReviewInput from src/operations/semantic-review.ts.
refined: ExecutionPlan.run() calls callOp for each added slot in the order: testWriterOp, implementerOp, verifierOp, semanticReviewOp, adversarialReviewOp, rectification. Skipped slots are not called. addSemanticReview and addAdversarialReview reference the existing ops from src/operations/semantic-review.ts and src/operations/adversarial-review.ts (verified by op.name === "semanticReviewOp" and "adversarialReviewOp").

original: ExecutionPlan.run() dispatches every phase via callOp(ctx, slot.op, slot.input) — no calls to agentManager.runWithFallback, no per-slot runner closures, no outer-scope sharedState mutation.
refined: ExecutionPlan.run() implementation contains calls to callOp for each phase (verified by grep/AST). Contains zero calls to agentManager.runWithFallback. OrchestratorSlot interface does not include a runner or closure field. No mutable sharedState variable is declared or mutated in ExecutionPlan.run().

original: ExecutionPlan.run() returns StoryOrchestratorResult.success === false (no throw) when any op returns { success: false }; thrown errors are logged with { storyId, phase: op.name, error } and propagated.
refined: When callOp returns { success: false }, ExecutionPlan.run() continues and returns with success: false. When callOp throws, ExecutionPlan.run() logs with structure { storyId: ctx.story.id, phase: op.name, error: errorMessage(err) } and re-throws the error.

original: StoryOrchestratorResult captures per-slot costs in phaseCosts (keyed by op.name), their sum as totalCostUsd, and parsed phase outputs in phaseOutputs (keyed by op.name, typed Record<string, unknown> with read-site narrowing).
refined: StoryOrchestratorResult.phaseCosts is a Record<string, number> with keys equal to op.name of each dispatched phase. StoryOrchestratorResult.totalCostUsd equals the sum of all phaseCosts values. StoryOrchestratorResult.phaseOutputs is Record<string, unknown> with keys equal to op.name; type narrowing occurs at read sites adjacent to the named op.

original: addRectification(opts) loops per §2D: reads failures from phaseOutputs[verifierOp.name], resolves the fix via runFixCycle(opts.strategies, ...), dispatches via callOp, re-runs the verifier, and terminates on success / maxAttempts / abortOnIncreasingFailures / abort signal.
refined: Rectification loop: reads failures as ReviewCheckResult[] from phaseOutputs[verifierOp.name]; calls runFixCycle(opts.strategies, failures, ctx) to select a fix; dispatches the chosen op via callOp; re-runs verifierOp via callOp and overwrites phaseOutputs[verifierOp.name]; terminates when verifier returns success: true OR attempt count >= opts.maxAttempts OR (opts.abortOnIncreasingFailures && newFailureCount > prevFailureCount) OR ctx.abort signal fires.

original: The rectification phase owns one SessionKeeper instance for the implementer session (constructed at phase entry, closed in .finally()); reuses the warm-lifetime implementer handle across iterations.
refined: Rectification phase constructs exactly one SessionKeeper instance at the start of the loop. The implementer op is dispatched with keepOpen: true, reusing the same SessionKeeper handle across all iterations. SessionKeeper.close() is called in a .finally() block that runs on exit (success, max attempts, abort, or error).

original: Both src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts and src/tdd/orchestrator.ts replace their internal session loops with StoryOrchestratorBuilder — no residual `if (isTddStrategy)` branch that duplicates session management.
refined: Both src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts and src/tdd/orchestrator.ts call `const plan = new StoryOrchestratorBuilder().add...().build(ctx); const result = await plan.run()`. Neither file contains session-management logic (openSession, closeSession, or SessionKeeper instantiation outside the builder). No branching on TDD strategy for session management (verified by grep for `if.*isTddStrategy.*session` or similar patterns returning zero matches).

original: tdd/orchestrator.ts retains rollback, verdict reading (readVerdict + categorizeVerdict on phaseOutputs[verifierOp.name]), isolation surfacing, greenfield-no-tests detection, priorFailures review-escalation skip, and the full-suite gate — none of these appear inside the builder or any op.
refined: src/tdd/orchestrator.ts contains calls to rollback, readVerdict, categorizeVerdict, isolation-surfacing logic, greenfield-no-tests check, priorFailures review-escalation skip, and full-suite gate. src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts (builder) contains zero references to rollback, readVerdict, categorizeVerdict, isolation, greenfield, priorFailures, or full-suite gate. No ops (implementerOp, verifierOp, etc.) in src/operations/ contain these responsibilities.
